about:
Pierce Manufacturing Company Inc. has operated in Kalispell, Montana since 1974. Founded as a small family-owned business, it remains under family ownership and serves the greater Flathead Valley area.

The company manufactures custom truck bodies and provides a full range of trailer repair and customization services. Its shop handles trailer suspension, brake, axle, bearing, and wiring work, as well as body repairs for campers and horse trailers. In-house fabrication produces custom flatbeds, front and rear bumpers, service bodies, headache racks, toolboxes, and accessory lighting. The team also installs liftgates, hoists, snowplows, auto-crane cranes, hitches, dump bodies, sanders, and tire holders. As a Steer In® Outpost, the company sells new trailers and stocks Dexter Axle components.

Customers include commercial trucking fleets, agricultural operators, construction firms, and recreational vehicle owners throughout northwestern Montana. The shop works on all makes of trucks and trailers, from light-duty pickups to heavy commercial units.

Pierce Manufacturing emphasizes competitive pricing, honest dealing, and on-time delivery as the foundation of its reputation. The company states that it holds itself to the same standard of excellence established at its founding, aiming to return every truck and trailer to working condition quickly.
